note: Every protocol step must reference a source id in this file. Steps whose content could not be confirmed against a primary source this session carry verified:false on the step, and the corpus test fails the build for any Tier A step in that state.

sources.title: Highlights of the 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for CPR and ECC
sources.citation: Del Rios M, Bartos JA, Panchal AR, et al. Part 1: executive summary: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care. Circulation. 2025;152(suppl 2). Published October 2025.
sources.comment: Heart & Stroke Foundation of Canada co-branded edition of the AHA Highlights. Figures carry the AHA copyright line. Algorithm text quoted verbatim into the corpus. NOTE: this is a delta document — it states what CHANGED in 2025 and does NOT restate unchanged numeric targets such as compression rate and depth.

sources.title: Part 7: Adult Basic Life Support: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for CPR and ECC
sources.citation: Part 7: Adult Basic Life Support: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation and Emergency Cardiovascular Care. Circulation. 2025;152(suppl 2). doi:10.1161/CIR.0000000000001369
sources.comment: BLOCKED. ahajournals.org returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches and sits behind a Cloudflare challenge; cpr.heart.org also 403s. The numeric targets attributed to this source (compression rate 100-120/min, adult depth 5-6 cm / 2-2.4 in, 30:2 lay-rescuer ratio, 2-minute rescuer swap) are long-standing values carried forward from the 2020 Guidelines and are NOT listed among the 2025 changes in aha2025-highlights, which is good evidence they are unchanged. They still require confirmation against the primary PDF before this app is put in front of a real bystander. Obtain the PDF manually and set verified:true.

sources.title: Updated CPR guidelines tackle choking response, opioid-related emergencies and a revised Chain of Survival
sources.comment: AHA's own plain-language release. Corroborates the choking changes independently of the Highlights PDF.
